value.rationale: The sharp 2-to-4 norm is a canonical concentration invariant of the first orthogonal-Grassmannian harmonic. Its optimizer changes from one-spike to half-positive/half-negative at an explicit rank product, yielding a nontrivial exact phase diagram and a 1/sqrt(5) asymptotic density threshold. Neither normalization nor invariant fourth moments alone imply the complete spectral phase classification.
